name: document-approval-workflow
description: Document approval workflow: submitters upload documents, reviewers approve or reject them.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "yarn workspace backend dev" "yarn workspace frontend dev"
scripts.build: yarn workspace backend build && yarn workspace frontend build
scripts.test: yarn workspace backend test && yarn workspace frontend test
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace backend typecheck && yarn workspace frontend typecheck
scripts.verify: yarn format:check && yarn lint && yarn typecheck
